Definition: adverb from G2121; opportunely:--conveniently, in season.
BiblicalUsage: eukaírōs is the word for conveniently, in season. In Mark 14:11, the text says "and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, eukaírōs means conveniently, in season, and I leave it at that.
